root_idea.summary: The root centers on heaviness or weight: heaviness in hearing, a carried load, and figuratively settled gravity, composure, and reverence.
root_idea.development: The semantic range develops from physical heaviness to auditory dullness and burden-bearing, then to calm stability, dignity, and honor. Several derived forms extend the load metaphor to things becoming laden or burdensome.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II perfect citation form وَقَّرَ.

senses.definition: To honor, revere, or treat with respectful regard.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction وَتُوَقِّرُوهُ, referring to treating him with honor and reverence.

senses.definition: Gravity, dignified composure, calmness, and forbearance.
senses.usage_conditions: A quality of settled dignity and self-restraint; it is one interpretation of the Quranic expression involving God's وَقَار.
A Quranic use applied to God, emphasizing divine majesty or grandeur rather than a human disposition.

senses.definition: Heaviness or dullness in the ear; deafness or loss of hearing.
senses.usage_conditions: A condition of the ear or hearing; the Quranic occurrences describe a disabling auditory heaviness that prevents proper hearing.

senses.definition: A load or weight carried upon the back or head.
senses.usage_conditions: A concrete burden or carried load; the lexical evidence does not restrict it to one particular animal or degree of heaviness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To load or cause to be laden; of a palm, to become laden with fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I usage corresponding to loading or becoming laden, including the cited palm-tree construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To settle, remain fixed, or leave a lasting impression in the heart, mind, or ear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of speech, a secret, or an idea becoming fixed and retained.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To sit, or to sit with gravity and composure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I usage describing sitting or remaining seated with dignity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become grave, steady, sedate, or calm; to show or strive for such gravity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I quality or behavior of composed seriousness. One reported interpretation of وَقِرْنَ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ takes it in this sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make still or quiet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to making a beast of carriage remain still.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To regard or deem someone grave, steady, or sedate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the evaluative sense of holding a person to possess gravity, distinct from treating him with honor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To load an animal or conveyance, especially heavily.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be a camel, beast, mule, or ass, and the load may be described as severe or heavy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To burden someone with debt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form IV construction in which debt is the burden.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a palm tree, to become laden or abundant with fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form IV use describing a fruit-bearing palm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel or similar animal, to become laden or overspread with fat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily condition expressed through the metaphor of being loaded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or receive one's load of grain or other food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X usage concerning taking possession of a food-load.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of camels, to become fat or heavy with fatness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form X usage describing accumulation of bodily fat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Grave, staid, sedate, calm, or composed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective of dignified composure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Heavily burdened with debt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a person under a heavy debt burden.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Steadfast or unshaken in heart.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a heart that does not flutter from fright.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Laden or bearing a heavy load.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to people, animals, and ships as well as other load-bearing things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a palm tree, laden or heavily laden with fruit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A participial description of a fruit-abundant palm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dull of hearing or deaf; of an ear, affected by auditory heaviness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial description applied both to a person and to the ear.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Experienced or seasoned.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical description of a person who has acquired experience.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large flock of sheep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective noun associated with the flock's size, gravity, and slow movement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hollow or depression in rock.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical branch explicitly treated as outside the principal semantic pattern.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A depression or cavity in a bone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare anatomical term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A follower or accompanying term associated with الفقير.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied lexical statement preserves this as a distinct rare branch, but does not clarify the precise referent of the expression إتباع الفقير.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form I loading or becoming laden.
Heaviness or deafness of the ear.
Settling or leaving an impression in ear, heart, or mind.
Being or showing gravity and composure.
Making a beast still or quiet.
Regarding someone as grave or sedate.
Treating someone with honor and respect.
A palm becoming laden with fruit.
An animal becoming covered or laden with fat.
Camels becoming fat or heavy with fatness.
Noun وَقْر for auditory heaviness or deafness.
Noun وِقْر for a carried load.
Greatness or majesty in the Quranic divine usage.
Adjective for a grave or sedate person.
A person, animal, or ship bearing a load.
A person or ear dull of hearing or deaf.

cautions: The Quranic وَقَار in 71:13 supports both a dignity/composure reading and a greatness or divine-majesty reading; both are retained as distinct senses.
The interpretation of وَقِرْنَ فِي بُيُوتِكُنَّ as 'be grave' is disputed in the supplied evidence; another interpretation derives it from sitting.
The rare وَقِير meaning described as إتباع الفقير is preserved, but its precise lexical referent is unclear in the supplied evidence.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: The rare Maqayis statement describing وَقِير as إتباع الفقير has been preserved as a cautious Classical meaning because the exact referent of that expression is not clarified.
